name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for senior home maintenance?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for senior home maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process typically begins with an initial consultation, either over the phone or at your home, to understand your specific needs and concerns. Following this, we schedule an on-site assessment to thoroughly evaluate the property and discuss potential solutions. We then provide a detailed proposal outlining the recommended services, materials, timeline, and associated costs. Once approved, our team schedules the work at your convenience and executes the project efficiently, keeping you informed throughout. We ensure all work is completed to high standards and your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes an initial consultation, on-site assessment, detailed proposal, and efficient project execution with regular communication.
